description: Read, edit, and program supported handheld radios from Android over USB or Bluetooth. Core programming works offline without a Field Programmer account.
releaseSummary: Bluetooth reconnects reuse the connection type that worked. This update also improves reconnect timing and retries and fixes model-specific Bluetooth settings during radio cloning.
featureOneDescription: Edit channels, import and export CHIRP CSV, and load preset channel plans. Online imports are available through RadioReference and myGMRS.
featureTwoDescription: Save your radio’s programming as a model-specific codeplug or use radio-to-radio cloning for compatible channels. The app validates frequencies and offers TX Inhibit on supported models.
featureThreeDescription: Organize channels into zones and edit DMR contacts, Radio ID, and APRS settings on the Baofeng DM-32.
supportedTitle: Find your radio. Know its status.
